posts.title: The task that failed to start and left asyncio stuck
posts.description: Failed context entry during eager start left the child recorded as the current task - I found this bug while fuzzing parts of asyncio. A failed task constructor could leave the event loop stuck, even if the caller caught the exception. posts.title: Reading __dict__ once permanently deoptimizes attribute access
posts.description: Since 3.11 attribute access has not been a dict lookup, and reading __dict__ once takes the specialized path away for good - Start with the oldest performance tip in Python. Pull the attribute out of the loop: class Attr: def process(self): self.value = 0 for i in range(1_000_000): self.value += i class Hoisted: def process(self): value = 0 for i in range(1_000_000): value += i self.value = value
